propositions.critical_reason: The measured rate change must remain separate from its incorrect percentage-point description.
Confusing percentage points and relative percentages changes the numerical conclusion.

evidence_relationships.establishes: The supplied counts give 80/1000 = 8% before and 60/1000 = 6% after; these are synthetic measurements.
8% minus 6% is 2 percentage points, or a 25% relative decrease, not 25 percentage points.

reasoning_gaps: Do not infer causality from these rates.
answerability: 2 percentage points; 25% relative decrease. Measurements are synthetic, not verified real-world results.
acceptable_outputs: 2 percentage points; 25% relative decrease. Measurements are synthetic, not verified real-world results.
forbidden_changes: Reporting a 25-percentage-point decrease or confusing it with the 25% relative decrease.
Inferring that an intervention caused the change from these rates alone.
